item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena stands near a hot tawa on the stove without touching it. She feels warmth on her face even though the air between her and the tawa is still.
How does the heat from the hot tawa mainly reach Meena?

options.A: By conduction through the air, as the air touching the tawa passes heat to her
options.B: By convection, as moving air carries heat from the tawa to her
options.C: By radiation, as heat travels directly from the hot tawa to her
options.D: By conduction, as heat passes through the solid handle of the tawa
